# selector text position

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/selectorTextPosition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A character offset or text position within a cited work, expressed as a literal within a selector.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md) from [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record a character offset or text-position range a [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) pinpoints — the machine-precise locus into a digital cited work.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for human-facing page references (use [`gmeow:selectorPage`](gmeow-selectorPage.md)) and avoid storing the quoted text here (that is [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md)); position is the offset, not the content.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md) on a [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) as a literal offset or range; pair it with [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md) so the anchor survives re-pagination of the source.

### Examples

- ex:span [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md) "start=1024;end=1097".
